WD-REPORT.description: Wall Design Report (WD-REPORT). Generates and exports an RC wall design report file; fields are driven by the DESIGN_WALL_REPORT_REQUEST DTO (report type, export target, per-type report mode, and optional wall/story selections).

REPORT_TYPE.description: Report type (case-insensitive). WID+STORY groups results by wall ID and story; WID groups by wall ID only.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Export directory path for the generated report (e.g. C:\MIDAS\Report\).

OUTPUT_NAME.description: Output file name for the generated report.

CURRENT_MODE_WID_STORY.description: [REPORT_TYPE=WID+STORY] Report mode (case-insensitive) used when REPORT_TYPE is WID+STORY.

CURRENT_MODE_WID.description: [REPORT_TYPE=WID] Report mode (case-insensitive) used when REPORT_TYPE is WID.

SELECTIONS.description: List of wall and story selections to include in the report. If omitted or empty, all walls and all stories are included.

items.description: One wall-ID set paired with one story set.

WALL_IDS.description: Wall ID object - specify each wall ID (KEYS) or a wall ID range (TO). If omitted, all walls are included.

STORY.description: Story names to filter the report. If omitted, all stories are included.
